description: Conversion of existing first floor flat into a surgery, part first floor rear extension, roof extension with front roof window and installation of solar panel to the roof of the building.
subdivision_of_building: Rear First Floor Extension. Roof conversion - Staff / Storage. Convert existing First Floor Flat into Surgery
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: PL7/SM/3124-00, PL7/SM/3124-01, PL7/SM/3124-02, PL7/SM/3124-03-A, PL7/SM/3124-04, PL7/SM/3124-05, PL7/SM/3124-06-A, PL7/SM/3124-07-A, PL7/SM/3124-08, PL7/SM/3124-09, PL7/SM/3124-10, Triple bin storage details, Secure bike storage details, Cover letter, Transport statement, Power details. Received: 11/03/2025
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 4 - The accommodation at first and second floor level shown on the plans hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the doctors surgery and notwithstanding the Town and Country Planning General Permitted Development Order (as amended), shall not be occupied as a dwelling or for any other purpose.
Reason - In the interests of Policy CI1 and to ensure that the accommodation provided is suitable for its intended purpose

Condition : 5 - Details of secure and sheltered storage for 2 long stay cycle parking space and 3 short stay cycle parking spaces, including manufacturer's specification, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The storage facilities, as approved, shall be provided prior to first use of the accommodation hereby permitted and shall thereafter be retained as such.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 6 - The waste and recycling storage shown on the plans hereby approved shall be shall be fully implemented prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted and retained thereafter and no waste or recycling shall be stored outside of those storage facilities.
Reason:  In the interests of the character and appearance of the area and to ensure that refuse can be properly stored and removed from the site as soon as the proposed use of these premises commences in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1, CC2 and EQ7.

Condition : 7 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Travel Plan in accordance with current Council and TfL guidance comprising immediate, continuing and long-term measures to promote and encourage a reduction in car use shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Travel Plan shall be implemented upon occupation, and thereafter monitored and reviewed in accordance with the agreed Travel Plan targets and timescales to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
 Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives, including a reduction in single occupancy car journeys and the increased use of public transport, walking and cycling.

Condition : 8 - The windows formed in the western elevation at first floor level and above shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy
